//: Second try at Snake Manor's hiss (the first round's shared negative prompt said 'hiss noise', which steered the model away from it). Four prompt styles; the pick replaces the hiss cue in sfx-cues.json. Plays when a banished player turns out to be a Snake.
negative: music, melody, speech, voice, words, breathing, wind, steam, white noise, static, radio noise, crowd, reverb, low quality

cues.use: Hiss, style A: a big snake, aggressive and close.
cues.prompt: Snake hiss sound effect. A large cobra hissing aggressively, sharp breathy reptile hiss, close up, dry studio recording, high quality foley

cues.use: Hiss, style B: slow and menacing, swells then fades.
cues.prompt: Slow menacing serpent hiss, long drawn out sss sound, swelling then fading, cinematic horror sound design, isolated, dry

cues.use: Hiss, style C: two short angry hisses, like a warning before a strike.
cues.prompt: Two short angry snake hisses, sharp attack, threatening warning, close microphone, isolated sound effect, nothing else

cues.use: Hiss, style D: a rattle, then a hiss (more dramatic).
cues.prompt: A rattlesnake shakes its rattle then hisses loudly, real reptile, close microphone, isolated sound effect, high quality recording
